item.text: The first regression test exposed an important testing constraint: the correct ceiling is ~24.8 days, so a real-time subprocess test cannot wait for it. I’m adjusting the fixture to intercept only the clamped timer and trigger that callback immediately, preserving a deterministic test of the exact delay passed to `setTimeout`.
